scoring_contract.boundary_metric: one-to-one nearest-prediction recall, any agenda item
scoring_contract.item_metric: one-to-one nearest-prediction recall, manual agenda association plus boundary

input_size_distribution.source: input_estimate_tokens from saved raw request artifacts; excludes six cohort meetings without a recorded call estimate
input_size_distribution.units: request-builder estimate units, not provider tokenizer counts

gemini/gemini-3.5-flash-lite.notes: Primary-key failures included input-token-per-minute 429s; two failed meetings recovered on the secondary key.

deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash.notes: The 85k run limit was a conservative experiment screen, not a model context limit.

deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash.high_context_prompt_calls: 0/4 valid across two independent packets and both prompts
deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash.notes: Four large real-packet requests hit NVIDIA/Cloudflare 504; no locator quality score is inferred from these failures.
deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash.large_packet_failure_detail: Both prompts on each of two independent packets ended in Cloudflare 504 after about 1,027 seconds.

routing_recommendation.prompt_basis: Paired-valid results favor transition_sweep for Gemini and DeepSeek V4; Kimi and GLM point estimates favor baseline, with small paired samples and overlapping meeting-cluster intervals.

tiers.use: primary for requests at or below the conservative ~101.8k builder-unit admission ceiling; split across its two 500 RPD keys
small/medium-context capacity alternate, screened below ~85k builder units; do not use for context overflow above its observed OrcaRouter failure band
tested overflow for packets above Gemini admission and within Kimi measured ~234k builder-unit ceiling
do not assign yet; current NVIDIA endpoint timed out on four large real-packet calls; requires endpoint/concurrency investigation
do not assign to long-context production overflow; OrcaRouter latency and 524 errors undermine its nominal RPD

routing_recommendation.throughput_gate: Current chapter-locator lane funds 3,255 row writes/day at 7 writes/job (about 465 jobs/day), below the 1,000-2,000/day objective even before model/provider limits.

throughput_note: Service-capacity figures derived as 86,400 seconds/day times configured concurrency divided by observed valid-call p90; provider limits and dispatch lane row-write budget can lower actual throughput.
